subject: Dinner Saturday?
text:
Hi Sam,

Are you free for dinner on Saturday? The new noodle place on Elm Street opens at 7.

Maya

subject: Re: Dinner Saturday?
text: Sounds great. Can we make it 7:30?

subject: Re: Dinner Saturday?
text: 7:30 works. Could you book a table for four? Bo and Lena are coming too.
